findings.title: Average truncated by integer division
findings.description: In the moved averageUnits(), `(double) units / rows.size()` became `units / rows.size()`; both operands are long/int so the division truncates (e.g. 7/2 = 3.0), and the report's average row is wrong; restore the cast.
findings.suggestion: Return `(double) units / rows.size()` as in the original.
